# Casco Studio

Casco Studio is an AI code studio and code editor. An agent writes and edits code with you inside the editor, and you can build complete websites with hosting in Arabic, English, or Hindi.
https://casco.studio/

## Subscription

Casco Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription for the code studio and editor. It is not only for websites. Hosting is a separate charge for each site.
https://casco.studio/pricing

## Download Casco Studio

Official download page for Windows and Mac: https://casco.studio/download
تنزيل Casco Studio للويندوز والماك: https://casco.studio/download
